products.name: Graph Mailbox Polling Workflows in Azure Logic Apps (Managed Identity, No Service Account) — Commercial
products.short_description: When a public webhook isn't an option, poll the mailbox the right way — a scheduled Logic App reads new mail through Microsoft Graph with a managed identity, watermarked and throttle-safe.
products.description:
When a public webhook isn't an option, poll the mailbox the right way — a scheduled Logic App reads new mail through Microsoft Graph with a managed identity, watermarked and throttle-safe.

Not every environment can expose a public HTTPS endpoint for Graph change notifications, and the Office 365 connector can't authenticate with a managed identity. The robust fallback is a scheduled Graph polling workflow — but done properly, not a naive 'get messages every 5 minutes' that double-processes mail and trips throttling. This solution builds a recurrence-driven Logic App that reads new messages via Microsoft Graph using a managed identity and application permission, tracks a high-water mark (delta query or received-time/isRead watermark) so each message is processed exactly once, handles Graph throttling/paging, and marks or moves processed items so work is never lost or repeated.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • The polling workflow — a recurrence-triggered Logic App querying Graph for new messages, authenticated by managed identity (no service account)
  • Exactly-once — delta-query or watermark strategy so messages aren't skipped or double-processed across runs
  • Throttling + paging — honoring Graph limits, @odata.nextLink paging, and backoff so a busy mailbox doesn't fail runs
  • Idempotent handling — mark-as-read / move-to-folder / dedup so a re-run is safe; cross-references #4 for one-mailbox scoping
  • Validation — scripts that confirm the identity reads only the target mailbox and the watermark advances correctly

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A dependable, credential-free mailbox polling workflow that reads each message exactly once over Graph — the right pattern when an event-driven webhook isn't available.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GRAPHPOLL-Discovery.ps1 — read-only inventory for the "Graph Mailbox Polling Workflows in Azure
    • GRAPHPOLL-Report.ps1 — processing / backlog report for the "Graph Mailbox Polling Workflows in Azure
    • GRAPHPOLL-Set-AppRole.ps1 — assign (or verify) the least-privilege Microsoft Graph APPLICATION
    • GRAPHPOLL-Test-Watermark.ps1 — read-only exactly-once check: simulates two consecutive watermarked
    • GRAPHPOLL-Validate.ps1 — PASS/FAIL readiness check for the "Graph Mailbox Polling Workflows in Azure

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
